cohort: 1204 HIV-exposed infants born to mothers enrolled in the prevention of mother-to-child transmission (PMTCT) programme in Harare, Zimbabwe
finding: Early initiation of combination antiretroviral therapy (ART) reduced the prevalence of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of HIV at 6 weeks to 2.5%.
mod_finding: Mixed feeding increased the odds of HIV infection in infants.
